title: 举高小手问好
brief: EMPTY HANDS. Face viewer, raise the RIGHT open palm HIGH ABOVE BERET, wave it from left to right in a broad arc, smile; other hand on chest. Four successive arm poses. Absolutely no flowers.

title: 被提起时护住贝雷帽
brief: Invisible hand lifts her vertically by the back of the cardigan: both boots clearly dangling with bent knees; both hands clutch left/right edges of her cream beret so it does not fly off. Legs swing, beanie stays on, then land. Hands MUST touch the top of her head.

title: 转动小魔方
brief: Hold a large, clearly cubic 3x3 Rubik puzzle at chest height. Saturated red blue yellow green individual tiles, thick black dividing grid, three visible faces. One hand anchors lower block, the other turns top row 45°, snaps it aligned and shows cube. No food.

title: 棋差一步皱眉
brief: Sitting beside a clear CHESSBOARD with white and black chessmen. Move white knight, stare as black knight arrives, furrow brows with crooked mouth and hand to forehead, then reconsider. Chessmen + checkerboard unmistakable. No money, no coins.

title: 揉揉眼睛伸懒腰
brief: Wake from sleep seated hugging scarf, rub both closed eyes with little fists, yawn, then stretch arms up and stand. No unrelated objects.

title: 清晨舒展双臂
brief: Standing upright with empty hands. Lace fingers near chest, extend both arms fully and symmetrically above head in a long overhead stretch, lean slightly to one side, lower arms. Distinct full-body stretch, no teacup.

title: 小声哼一支歌
brief: Contentedly HUM a tiny tune with closed eyes and a small pursed singing mouth, hand on chest then finger conducting the beats. Two small clearly musical eighth-note symbols near head change place across the four poses.

title: 发梢随呼吸
brief: Quiet relaxed standing neutral with both boots firmly planted at the SAME baseline. Gentle inhales and exhales raise then settle shoulders subtly; long loose hair tips softly rise, fall. Eyes open then blink. No dancing, jumping or any props.

title: 午间捧起饭团
brief: Big WHITE TRIANGULAR ONIGIRI, with a distinctive rectangular sheet of dark nori around its base. Lift with both hands to mouth, bite a corner, show the bitten triangular rice ball. Large pure white rice grains, clearly different from cup or bun.

title: 尝一颗字节糖
brief: Large translucent bright turquoise pixel-shaped hard CANDY in twisted clear candy wrapper. Unwrap striped twist, lift square glowing sugar cube with two fingers, taste, smile. A candy, no drink nor rice.

title: 掰开一块曲奇
brief: Large single round CHOCOLATE CHIP cookie with visible chocolate spots held in both hands. Snap it cleanly through center, then hands pull apart holding TWO separated half cookies; share one toward viewer. Crumbs flying in middle two frames.

title: 月下分你一块月饼
brief: Small crescent moon motif next to beret. Show a round GOLD EMBOSSED scalloped mooncake on a plate, divide into wedges exposing lotus paste and orange yolk, extend one wedge toward viewer. Keep food large and recognizable, NO red envelope.

title: 抱着围巾合上眼
brief: Start awake standing; sit down and gather her long soft folded TAUPE SCARF in both hands; cuddle it against one cheek and very visibly close her eyes; end fully asleep with head tilted. Full body.

title: 风声里的梦
brief: Remain curled up SLEEPING HORIZONTALLY, lying on her side on a small pale pillow across ALL four frames, both eyes closed, scarf used as blanket; a tiny dream cloud with a star drifts and changes. Very different silhouette from standing.

title: 靠着围巾小睡
brief: Seated from the side, feet stretched forward, cheek leans slowly onto a rolled scarf pillow tucked over one arm. Nods off, tilts forward slightly, small quiet 'sleep bubble' expands, hands relax. No standing.

title: 垂下眼睛轻轻叹气
brief: Sad standing posture, eyebrows slant up at center then shoulders visibly slump, head down, open mouth exhales a small clearly visible puff; raise eyes slightly at end. Empty hands, no yawn or cover face.

title: 被叫到名字红了脸
brief: Standing looking away; ears perk, turn toward viewer in surprise, obvious rosy blushing cheeks in color and hands press both cheeks, shy smile. Empty hands, no coffee or props.

title: 没忍住笑出声
brief: Attempt not to laugh with puffed cheeks, press finger to her lips, then burst into wide open-mouthed laughter with smiling crescent eyes, one hand on belly while shoulders shake, end catching breath. Empty hands.

title: 轻轻别过脸
brief: Front gaze, turn head away to a clearly visible profile on the right; eyes sideways, lightly pout, fold both arms across chest, look back over shoulder. Bare hands no toy or cup.

title: 隔着屏幕轻声呼唤
brief: Looks directly at viewer, lean forward and CUP BOTH EMPTY HANDS around her MOUTH to softly call toward YOU, then extend palm toward viewer, face friendly. No physical monitor, no object.

title: 收起最后一枚星币
brief: Display a single large gold star coin in one hand and an entirely empty open leather pouch in the other; insert that last coin, let go, finally tie shut the empty-looking purse. Absolutely no tasting. Distinct interaction.

title: 逐枚数剩下的星币
brief: Three or four LARGE gold star coins on a tiny cloth mat, pointed downwards finger COUNTS them ONE BY ONE, moving one coin at a time between two piles, furrow worried brows, no board or chess pieces.

title: 烤炉旁等年糕
brief: Small miniature brick OVEN gives off orange glow; she kneels and watches two RECTANGULAR lightly charred white mochi rice-cakes on an open wire grill, they puff up over successive frames, she lifts one with chopsticks. No pot or soup.

title: 营地的热汤
brief: One rustic CAMPFIRE tripod pot and a generous steaming enamel mug of vegetable soup. Ladle steaming soup, wrap hands around the mug, gently blow on steam and take a sip. Visible vegetables, firewood and spoon.

title: 等你点头时踱步
brief: Impatient but polite pacing with both hands behind her back, eyebrows lifted questioning. Two distinct SIDE VIEW walking steps facing RIGHT, then turn to walk LEFT and stop facing viewer, hand open for approval. Not dragging/falling.

title: 城堡里的圆舞曲
brief: ELEGANT WALTZ. Lift skirt lightly with left hand, other arm rounded overhead, cross pointed ballet feet for a half-turn, back three-quarter view during pivot, then bow. Same regular clothes; no mask or instruments.

title: 踩着节拍摇摆
brief: Bouncy rhythmic sway side-to-side like a dancer, bend knees and pop hip left, shift right, arms counterbalance; snap fingers, small rhythmic beats near hand. No sports balls, no kicking shuttlecocks.

title: 困倦也要跳支舞
brief: Sleepy with drooping eyelids, raises one arm in a dance pose, does a tiny shuffle step while covering a yawn, slips and catches balance, ends on a small bow. No lantern or any props.

title: 偷吃一块饼干
brief: Sneak one small round scalloped biscuit from an OPEN COOKIE TIN, glance furtively, take a bite off the edge and hide the half-bitten cookie behind back when caught; crumb near mouth. Comedic expression.

title: 把饺子送进汤里
brief: A row of 3 plump white crescent DUMPLINGS with crimped edges, open stew pot. Hold a dumpling with chopsticks above hot broth, lower into water, visible tiny splash and ladle lifting a second crescent. No balls or cakes.

title: 让我再想一想
brief: Pause thoughtfully, support chin with one hand, tap temple with one finger, look up with open thoughtful eyes, raise one finger as an idea forms. No chessboard or food. Small thought bubbles.

title: 遮住一个哈欠
brief: Start sleepy, open mouth wide in a long yawn, politely cover the mouth with one palm, eyelids watering and close, then smile sheepishly. Standing stable, empty hands, no waving.
